phases.name: Fix GraphQL Operation Names
phases.description: Add named operations to all 5 anonymous GraphQL query strings in queries.go so they match the operationName sent by client.go

subtasks.description: Add operation names to all 5 anonymous query constants in internal/leetcode/queries.go: getUserProfile, questionOfToday, getRecentSubmissionList, getUserSolvedProblems, getProblemDetails. Each query's operation name must match the opName string passed in the corresponding client.go method call.
